summary: Oaktree Specialty Lending Corporation filed an 8-K on September 11, 2026, disclosing an underwriting agreement dated September 9, 2026, for a $300.0 million issuance of 7.000% notes due 2031. Net proceeds are $296.5 million after a $2.6 million underwriting discount and roughly $0.8 million in expenses. Closing is expected September 16, 2026, subject to customary conditions. J.P. Morgan, BNP Paribas, ING, RBC and SMBC Nikko act as underwriter representatives under an effective Form N-2 shelf. This is a routine debt capital raise, not a special situation.
